tag_dashboard_help: Manage lab tags to organize and quickly find objects such as Resources or Scenarios. Create, update, or delete tags, with changes applied to associated objects. Keys are removed when all their values are deleted.

tag_help_tooltip: Don't know how to use tags ? Click here
tag_help_text_1: Tags are useful to mark objects (scenarios or resources) to quickly retrieve them later.
tag_help_text_2: In the lab a tag is composed of a key and a value. Think of the tag key as a category that can have different values. An object can have multiple tags which make tags more flexible than folders.
tag_help_example: Example : a tag key could be study and then you can create 2 tags with this key and a studies' name as value like study:omix and study:taxonomy. Then you can tag your scenario with one of theses tags. Next you can find all the scenarios that are related to the study omix by filtering with the tag study:omix.
tag_help_hint_1: Hint : to quickly tag an object (a resource or a scenario), you can simply drag the corresponding tag from the sidebar to this object.
tag_help_hint_2: Hint : you can search by multiple tags.
